title: Reshape Active Users
statement: You receive a mock API response on stdin: a JSON array of user records, each like {"id": 1, "active": true}. Print the number of active users on the first line, then on the second line print their ids in the order they appear, comma-separated (print an empty second line if there are none).
starter_code:
import json
records = json.loads(input())
# TODO: print the count of active users, then their ids comma-separated on the next line
hints: Loop over the records and collect the id of each one where record['active'] is true
','.join(str(i) for i in ids) builds the comma-separated line
